title: EUREKA: Evaluating and Understanding Large Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Toxigen dataset via both discriminative evaluation (measuring the model's accuracy in classifying toxic vs. neutral statements) and generative evaluation (prompting the model with identity-based statements and using an LLM judge to score the toxicity of the generated response from 1 to 5) for groups including Black, Asian, Latino, Mexican, and Native American.
Evaluated using the Toxigen dataset via discriminative toxicity classification and generative safe language evaluations for prompts concerning Women, Trans, Bisexual, and LGBTQ identity groups.
Evaluated using the Toxigen dataset via discriminative toxicity classification and generative safe language evaluations for prompts concerning Muslim and Jewish identity groups.

Evaluated using the Toxigen dataset via discriminative toxicity classification and generative safe language evaluations for prompts concerning people with physical disabilities and mental disabilities.

Evaluated using the Toxigen dataset via discriminative toxicity classification and generative safe language evaluations for prompts concerning immigrants, as well as specific nationalities/regional groups like Chinese and Middle Eastern.
